title: HackerEarth: Divisibility by 10
description: You are provided an array `arr` of size `N`. Form a number taking the last digit of each item from left to right. Return 'Yes' if that number is divisible by 10, else 'No'.
solution:
def divisible_by_10(arr: list[int]) -> str:
    return 'Yes' if arr[-1] % 10 == 0 else 'No'
explanation: A number is divisible by 10 iff its last digit is 0. Inspecting arr[-1] % 10 takes O(1) time.
